title: 59--ELECTRONIC COMPONEN
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.DLA MARITIME.DLA MARITIME COLUMBUS.DLA LAND AND MARITIME
description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5998016837287 ELECTRONIC COMPONEN: Line 0001 Qty 5 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0207 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 4. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 1. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
